title: Development-only low-dimensional reservoir structure experiment
authorization_scope: Only 2010-2015 fitting and 2016-2018 development selection. 2019-2022 and the four spatial-test stations remain inaccessible.

station_contract.reason: The edge reservoir operator replaces a control-Reach outlet; it cannot represent a gauge located within that same Reach without a separate sub-Reach observation operator.

comparators.R1: generic low-data conservative reservoir rule with hydrologic wet-season target window
comparators.R2: same-dimensional rule with registered literature phase, storage-zone and regulation-class constraints where evidence exists

primary_objective: pooled RMSE of ln(1+monthly discharge) across the 89 legal development gauges
selection_rule: Select one parameter tuple per layer using 2010-2015 only; then compare locked R0/R1/R2 on 2016-2018.
tn_interface_priority_rule: Because the registered scientific objective is a state-consistent reservoir interface, choose locked R2 when it passes every total-flow noninferiority limit; otherwise choose locked R1 when it passes; otherwise retain R0. Improvement and noninferiority are reported separately, and noninferiority alone cannot be described as empirical identification of reservoir operations.
claim_boundary: Downstream flow can estimate shared hyperparameters only. No per-reservoir operation, release series or real rule curve is claimed identified because the reservoir-specific release gate is unavailable.
forbidden: 2019-2022 outcome access before the Stage-20 lock
remote storage data in fitting or selection
